name: @partneriq-io/node
description: Official Node.js SDK for PartnerIQ: conversions, refunds, attribution, tracking links and signed webhooks.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --external:node:crypto --outfile=dist/index.mjs --format=esm --sourcemap && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --external:node:crypto --outfile=dist/index.cjs --format=cjs --sourcemap && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && node --test test/client.test.mjs
